candidates.topic: Measles outbreak in Pennsylvania — unvaccinated woman's death linked to complications
candidates.recommended_angle: What measles complications actually look like — and why this death is a warning sign, not an outlier
candidates.why_now: Real-time Google Trends breakout term tied to a confirmed county coroner finding; measles resurgence intersects directly with vaccine-hesitancy trends the audience already searches.
candidates.primary_headline: A Pennsylvania Woman Died of Measles Complications — Here's What That Means for the Current Outbreak
candidates.next_steps: Assign to health/infectious-disease writer today; confirm current case count via CDC measles dashboard before publishing; pull direct coroner quote if available.
integrity_flags: Confirm current national case count directly from CDC before publishing — do not rely on secondhand aggregation.
Frame vaccination-status context factually; do not imply blame toward the individual.
candidates.trend_score_reason: Real-time Google Trends breakout tied to confirmed coroner finding; measles resurgence theme.
candidates.opportunity_score_reason: High audience search intent on vaccine-hesitancy + outbreak risk; durable explainer angle.
candidates.discover_score_reason: Named entity + primary institutional source + public-health urgency = high AI-citation likelihood.
candidates.notes: Standard source validation applied (not a 02b trigger — cause-of-death finding, not a drug/dosage/supplement claim).

candidates.topic: E. coli outbreak linked to Walmart Great Value frozen blueberries
candidates.recommended_angle: The specific lot codes, symptoms, and states affected — a practical action guide, not just a recall alert
candidates.why_now: CDC outbreak notice and retailer recall broke within the last 72 hours; food-safety search interest is up 29% this week.
candidates.primary_headline: Great Value Frozen Blueberries Recalled After E. Coli Outbreak — What to Check in Your Freezer
candidates.next_steps: Confirm affected lot codes/states directly from CDC page; verify recall is still active before publish.
integrity_flags: Confirm recall is still open/active at time of publish — recall status changes quickly.
candidates.trend_score_reason: CDC outbreak + retailer recall within 72h; food-safety Trends +29% this week.
candidates.opportunity_score_reason: High practical consumer action value; direct institutional sourcing (CDC + retailer confirmation).
candidates.discover_score_reason: Actionable recall alert with specific lot codes and state targeting.

issues: The CDC entry describes an E. coli outbreak linked to frozen blueberries generically, with no brand named, while the Today.com entry describes a Walmart Great Value 'berries' recall without specifying blueberries; the evidence does not confirm these are the same product or the same outbreak, so presenting them as one linked event overstates what's verified.
fact_check.checked_against: CDC 'E. coli Outbreak Linked to Frozen Blueberries' notice and TODAY.com 'Walmart Great Value Berries Recalled for Possible E. Coli Contamination' headline

candidates.primary_headline: Why Food Recalls Keep Happening: Inside the Decline in FDA Foreign Inspections

integrity_flags: Attribute inspection-decline statistics to their original FDA/GAO source, not PBS's framing — verify before publishing.

candidates.opportunity_score_reason: Highest differentiation — no competitor covering systemic inspection-decline angle, only individual recalls.
candidates.discover_score_reason: Investigative food-safety infrastructure angle with public policy data tie.
candidates.notes: Strongest differentiation opportunity of the day — no competitor is covering the systemic angle, only individual recalls.

candidates.topic: Nature review: global rise in youth mental health diagnoses
candidates.recommended_angle: What's actually driving the rise — better detection, more distress, or both? A grounded explainer, distinct from the digital-media-specific angle already covered this week
candidates.why_now: Published in Nature this week; mental health search interest is up 45% in the last 7 days, the largest delta of any tracked category.
candidates.primary_headline: Youth Mental Health Diagnoses Are Rising Worldwide — Here's What the Research Actually Shows
candidates.next_steps: Pull specific diagnosis-rate figures and study methodology from the Nature article; distinguish from 9/8's digital-media-driver piece by focusing on diagnostic/detection trends broadly.

candidates.opportunity_score_reason: High audience search intent on youth mental health; builds on existing coverage with new peer-reviewed angle.
candidates.discover_score_reason: Peer-reviewed research gate + diagnosis-rate methodology angle.
candidates.notes: content_status = update: builds on 9/8 digital-media pediatric psychiatric crisis coverage with new peer-reviewed global diagnosis-rate data — a distinct driver-agnostic angle.
